entry.title: 予知/遠隔視 めいた事例
entry.content:
前置き​

たぶん、すぐ忘れるので記録しておく。

今朝方（2024-12-29 早朝）、いつもの仕事の夢を見ていた。その夢が突如、切り替わり、ゆっくり降りてきた大型航空機が地上で爆発・炎上する場面になった。あたりは騒然となり、そこで目覚めた。

以下の場面がその夢のシーンにかなり似ている。

だが、下のシーンは似ていない。

なお、このような大事故の夢を見た記憶はほとんどない。予知夢は何度か経験がある。なので、予知夢や無自覚の遠隔視の可能性も無いではないが、まぁ、偶然だろう。

備考​

2024-12-29 09:07 チェジュ航空2216便事故。179人が死亡。

動画(9:52)​

Jeju Air jet crash: Death toll rises to at least 151 people in South Korea | DW News

www.youtube.com/watch?v=k_c6miE5xHw

動画概要欄​

291,300 views

Dec 29, 2024 #jetcrash #southkorea #planecrash A passenger jet has crashed upon landing in South Korea, killing at least 151 people. The Jeju Air flight from Bangkok skidded off the runway at Muan International Airport, crashed into a barrier and burst into flames. 181 people were on board the flight. Only two people have been rescued from the tail section of the Boeing 737-800. Officials say there's little chance of finding other survivors, which would make it South Korea's worst aviation disaster.

entry.title: David Grusch と Michael Schratt は共に自閉スペクトラム症
entry.content:
前置き​

些細な情報だが記録しておく。DSM-5 の病態定義は広すぎて疑問だが。

FasterWhisper AI(large-v2 model) + DeepL(2024-07 model)​

そして今、UFOの世界では、グルシュが自閉症スペクトラムであることを理由に、グルシュの信憑性を絶対視する人たちが大勢います。 このようなことを通して私が学んだことのひとつは、昔はアスペルガー病と呼んでいたことです。高度な知能を持ちながら、感情を表に出さない、あるいは公の場での適切な振る舞い方がわからない、先ほど言ったように感情をあまり表に出さない。 (0:02:16)

そして今、アスペルガーは自閉症の一種であると言われていると思います。それがデイヴィッド・グラッシュについて学んだことです。そして、私はUFOコミュニティが本当に持つ必要があると信じています...多くのメンバーは、自閉症の人、高機能自閉症の人が、彼のような立場にいることに悩むだろうと考えることに対して、良い揺さぶりをかける必要があると思います。あなたはどう思いますか、ティム？ (0:02:46)

ああ、これは問題ではないと思う。唯一、彼の物言いが通常期待されるものと一致しないことがあるかもしれません。でも、それ以外は、彼の物腰や話し方や動作から何かを読み取ろうとする人がいない限り、本当に、これは問題にすらならないと言えるでしょう。 (0:03:20)

私はそうは思わない。つまり、私たちはみんな違うんです。それに、もしかしたら僕もスペクトラムかもしれない。ただ、検査を受けたことがないんだ。だから、これは非常にゆるやかなことのひとつだと思う。 でも、このような人にとっては、問題ではない。 (0:03:44)

彼はそれを、本当に大したことのないことだと言っている。そしてそうではない。だから、それが公になっていること、そしてそれが異なるセクションによって異なる評価を受けていることが興味深い。明らかに、弾薬として使えるものは何でもそうなる。だから、私にとっては、ごく簡単に言ったように、この件に関する私の最初の意見は、問題ではないということになる。そして、それは彼のパフォーマンスの問題ではないと認識されるべきだという事実については、私も同意する。 (0:04:31)

私も100％そう思う。私が言いたいのは、これ以上時間をかけたくないのですが、UFOの一般大衆は、彼がUFOに関して持ってきたメッセージに対して、彼が偽りであるとするあらゆる種類の理由を探しているということです。 (0:05:06)

なるほど。そして、多くの人々が、この男には感情がない、みたいな文句を言っている。この男には感情がない、淡々と話している、偽物に違いない。しかし、UFOコミュニティは、航空史家マイケル・シュラットを愛してやまない。そして、マイケル・シュラットはアスペルガーにも苦しんでいる。なるほど。マイケルはパイロットだ。彼は高級防衛関係の仕事をしている。 (0:05:37)

なるほど。彼は多くの本を書いています。彼の研究は完璧だ。しかし、もしあなたがマイケルと一緒にいるとしたら、彼が抱える困難の一つは公共の場にいることです。しかし、彼が研究している時、あるいはスピーチをしている時、彼はその通りなんだ。まったくその通り。完全に集中してる。 (0:06:01)

マイケル・シュラットについてジム・グドールに話を聞くと、彼は、マイケル・シュラットはこの分野がこれまでに見た中で最も偉大な研究者の一人だと言うだろう。そう、アスペルガーなんだ。デヴィッド・グラッシュと同じだ。だから、アスペルガーがどういうもので、自閉症スペクトラムのどこに位置するのか、人々が実際に下調べをしたのなら、ティム、これは問題ではないということに100％同意するよ。不利ではない。 (0:06:35)

ええ、不利ではありません。どちらかと言えば、大きな利点だ。可能性がある。彼の言っていることをより真剣に受け止めることができる。

▼原文 展開

And now there's a bunch of people in the UFO world who are absolutely grading Grush's credibility because he's on the autism spectrum. Now, one of the things that I have learned through this all is a long time ago, we used to call it Asperger's disease, which is somebody who is highly intelligent, does not maybe show emotion or not know how to act properly in a public setting, doesn't really show a lot of emotion, as I just said, in regards to subjects where they're so brain focused on learning everything about it that that's all they could think about, and that's all they could concentrate on. (0:02:16)

And I believe that Asperger's now is being described as a form of autism. So that is something that I have learned about David Grush. And I really do believe that the UFO community really needs to have... many members need to have a good shaking over thinking that somebody with autism, high functioning autism, would have troubles being in the position that he was. What's your thoughts on this, Tim? (0:02:46)

Oh, I think this is a non-issue. You know, the only thing that may come to play is some of his mannerisms may not go in line with what is normally expected. But I would say other than that, really, this is not an issue, really, to even be brought up, unless people are trying to decipher anything by his mannerisms or the way he talks or operates. (0:03:20)

I don't think that... I mean, we're all different, like you could probably pick apart the way I operate. And who knows, maybe I'm on the spectrum as well. I've just never been tested. So I think it's one of those things that's very loose, you know, with some people, it's very prevalent, some people it's not. But again, for somebody, you know, like this, it's not an issue. (0:03:44)

He offers it up as just something that is really not a big deal. And it's not. So interesting that it's public knowledge, and that it's being weighed out differently by different sections. You know, obviously, anything that can be used as ammunition often will be. And so it's going to be one of those things to me, like I said, very briefly, in my first opinion on this is it's a non-issue. And I agree with you on the fact that it is, and it should be recognized as a non-issue of his performance. (0:04:31)

And I 100% agree. The point that I'm getting at is, and I don't want to spend too much more time on this, is the UFO public is looking for any sort of reasoning to make him disingenuine towards the message that he brought regarding UFOs, which I think is very bombshell dropping, including, I mean, look at my reaction that I had when he mentioned, finally, that we have the pilots of the craft. (0:05:06)

Okay. And there's a lot of people complaining, like, there's no emotion in this guy. There's no, you know, he's talking so matter of fact, it's got to be, it's got to be fake. Yet the UFO community are absolutely in love with, or adore, aviation historian Michael Schradt. And Michael Schradt also suffers from Asperger's. Okay. Michael is a pilot. He works a high-end defense job. (0:05:37)

Okay. People, he's written numerous books. His research is perfect. But if you're with Michael, one of the difficulties he has is being in public places. But when he's researching, or whether he's giving a speech, he's bang on, man. Absolutely bang on. And total focus. (0:06:01)

And you talk to Jim Goodall about Michael Schradt, he'll tell you that Michael Schradt is one of the greatest researchers this field has ever seen. Yep, suffers from Asperger's. And it's the same as David Grush. So if people actually did their homework on what Asperger's is about and where it falls in the autism spectrum, Tim, I 100% agree with you that this is a non-issue. Not a disadvantage. (0:06:35)

Yeah, it's not a disadvantage. If anything, it's a major advantage. Potentially. To take him more seriously in what he's saying.

動画(46:21)​

entry.title: 益子祐司 : Valiant Thor（金星人）は Frank E. Stranges の創作で実在しない
entry.content:
前置き​

雑ネタ。過去記事で、

言うまでもなく、Valiant Thor の話は Frank Stranges の捏造したヨタ話。

ref: Phil Schneider : Valiant Thor に会った。 （途中：その1） - http://news21c.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-15685.html (2020-03-31)

と述べたが、同様の趣旨の Valiant Thor に関する記事を見かけたので記録しておく。

予備知識​

Glen Danison : Valiant Thor の写真に登場する ET は俳優の Rory Calhoun だと暴露ずみだ (2022-05-08)

Frank E. Stranges の証言動画：米大統領にメッセージを伝えた金星人にペンタゴンで会った　（途中：その3） (2017-06-14)

Glenn Steckling : Valiant Thor が私の父に政府の情報撹乱工作員だと認めた (2022-05-12)

引用​

金星人といえば、「銀河連合」の大使等と紹介される「金星人ヴァリアント・ソー」について語る自称コンタクティたちがいますが、ヴァリアント・ソーとは、自称コンタクティのフランク・ストレンジズが作り上げた架空の人物です。ストレンジズはヴァリアント・ソーと1950年代末から1960年代初頭まで何度も会い、宇宙船にまで同乗したという話を1990年代になって急に語り始めましたが、彼が自著に掲載するヴァリアント・ソーの写真はすべて、1950年代に金星人や土星人と会ったというハワード・メンジャーの集会でオーガスト・ロバーツ氏が撮影した複数の写真を無断で盗用しているものです。何度も会っているという相手の写真をストレンジズ本人は１枚も持っていません。

この事実はあまり知られていないため、自称コンタクティたちは、ヴァリアント・ソーと会ったという体験を不用意に語り、自分たちの宇宙人ビジネスが作り話を土台にしたものであることを自ら証明してしまっているのです。そもそも、銀河連合にまつわる話自体が、UFOビジネスで暗黙の了承のもとに使われている架空の話に過ぎないものですが、それを見抜けない自称「意識高い系」の人たちが商売を支える顧客となっています。簡単にいえば、ヴァリアント・ソーの名前を出した時点で、作り話を語っていることを白状しているようなものです。さらにいえば「宇宙連合」等の言葉が出た時点で、それ以上の話を聞くのは時間の無駄でしかありません（娯楽として読む場合は別ですが）

ref: オムネク・オネクについて – 益子祐司 ブログ http://emerald.holy.jp/?page_id=1414

(2024-12-29)

entry.title: 金星人が講演している半世紀以上昔の動画
entry.content:
前置き​

見かけたので記録しておく。当然、金星人は自称だが本人（Omnec Onec）の意思を尊重したタイトルにした（のであって釣りなどではないw）。

  • 彼女には著書もある(*1)。
  • Wikipedia には日本語のページしか存在しない(*2)。
  • 日本語訳の訳者の Web 解説記事がかなり詳細(*3)

文字起こしを付けた。

(*1)​

"From Venus I Came: Autobiography of an Extraterrestrial (The Venusian Trilogy, Band 1)"

Autobiography of an Extraterrestrial: A Guide to Self-Realization and Ascension by a Woman who came to Earth with a Mission of Love and Brotherhood

Omnec Onec came here to Earth from the Astral Plane of Planet Venus. She came as a child, in a physical body, in a spaceship. She arrived in 1955 and was raised by an Earth family. In her autobiography, Omnec explains the history, culture, and spiritual teachings of the Venusians, who have lived on the Astral Plane for a very long time and who are part of our ancestry. She tells us about her first years of life, which were spent on Venus, and about her Venusian Family. She explains why and how she came to Earth, and the mission that she was to fulfill. As a sister planet to Earth, Venus had already gone through a transformation to a higher consciousness and frequency, similar to what the Earth and many people are now experiencing. Venus at one time had a physical society on it’s surface as well, Omnec reveals, and in the course of its evolution ascended to a higher plane. The History of Venus, as described by Omnec, and the spirituality of the Venusians, are a Gift of Pure Love. By applying Omnec‘s teachings, we learn how Transformation into expanded consciousness and ascension into Higher realms can be mastered by people on Earth, in accordance with the Universal “Laws of the Supreme Diety”. This book is the authorized re-publication of the original version, as written by Omnec Onec in the late 1960s and as first published in the U.S.A in 1991 by Lt. Col. Ret. Wendelle C. Stevens.

ある地球外生命体の自伝： 愛と同胞愛の使命を帯びて地球にやってきた女性による、自己実現とアセンションへの道しるべ

オムネック・オネックは、惑星金星のアストラルプレーンから地球にやってきた。彼女は子供の頃、肉体を持ち、宇宙船に乗ってやって来た。彼女は1955年に地球に到着し、地球の家族によって育てられた。 オムネックは自伝の中で、非常に長い間アストラル平面に住み、私たちの祖先の一部である金星人の歴史、文化、スピリチュアルな教えについて説明している。金星で過ごした人生の最初の数年間と、金星人家族について。彼女が地球に来た理由と経緯、そして果たすべき使命について説明する。 地球の姉妹星として、金星はすでに高い意識と周波数への変容を遂げていた。オムネックが明らかにしたところによると、金星にはかつて物理的な社会が存在し、進化の過程でより高い次元へと昇っていったという。 オムネックが語る金星の歴史と金星人のスピリチュアリティは、純粋な愛の贈り物です。オムネックの教えを応用することで、私たちは、普遍的な「至高神の法則」に従って、拡大意識への変容と高次の領域へのアセンションが、地上の人々によってどのようにマスターできるかを学ぶことができる。 本書は、1960年代後半にオムネック・オネックによって書かれ、1991年に退役中佐であるウェンデル・C・スティーブンスによってアメリカで出版されたオリジナル版の公認再出版である。ウェンデル・C・スティーブンス

Omnec Onec

Omnec Onec ♡ Ambassador from Venus ♡

Omnec Onec was born on the astral level of the planet Venus and came to Earth with her own physical body in 1955. In the Ninetees, she became publicly known with her autobiography FROM VENUS I CAME. In this book, she portrays life on the astral level of Venus and describes why and how she was born there and why as a child she was given the opportunity to lower her vibrations, to manifest a physical body and to come to Earth at the age of seven in order to later in her life work as a spiritual teacher and fulfill her life cycles here on Earth.

Omnec Onec ♡ Ambassador from Venus ♡

オムネック・オネックは金星のアストラルレベルで生まれ、1955年に肉体をもって地球にやってきた。1960年代、彼女は自叙伝『FROM VENUS I CAME（金星から来た私）』で公に知られるようになった。この本の中で、彼女は金星のアストラルレベルでの生活を描き、なぜ、どのようにして金星に生まれたのか、そしてなぜ子供の頃に波動を下げ、肉体を現し、後にスピリチュアル・ティーチャーとして働き、この地球でのライフサイクルを全うするために7歳で地球に来る機会を与えられたのかについて述べている。

(*2)​

オムネク・オネク（Omnec Onec, 1948年 - ）　本名：シーラ・クリスティーナ・シュルツ（Shiela Christina Schultz）

『Ufo From Venus I Came』（Wendelle Stevens）の著者。 略歴

アストラル界の金星の都市・チュートニアから地球で残した自身のカルマの清算と金星のマスターから言い渡された使命を果たすために、幼少時に体を物理的な波動に落とし、1952年にアストラル界と物理的世界の中継都市・レッツから宇宙船で地球に飛来し、チベットの寺院で3年間過ごした後に、アーカンソー州で交通事故で死亡した7歳の少女と事故現場で入れ替わり、アメリカ人として生活し始めたと述べている。

テネシー州チャタヌーガで学校生活を送るが、後にシカゴに移る。スタン・シュルツ（Stan Schultz）と結婚。1976年に離婚をした後、ドイツに移り、1992年から世界平和のためのワークショップや講演などで欧州を回る。 著作リスト

私はアセンションした惑星から来た（益子祐司/訳、徳間書店 2008年3月 ISBN 978-4-19-862503-0　リスト下の「至高なる神性の法則」に改題新装 地球人になった金星人オムネク・オネク（益子祐司/訳、徳間書店 2011年2月 ISBN 978-4-19-863114-7 DVDから語りかける 金星人オムネク・オネク　地球を救う愛のメッセージ（益子祐司/訳、徳間書店 2011年12月 ISBN 978-4-19-863308-0 金星人オムネクとの対話 スターピープルたちにいま伝えたいこと（益子祐司/訳、T.O.エンタテイメント 2013年11月 ISBN 978-4-86472-185-1 アセンションした惑星からやってきた 金星人オムネクの答え ユニバーサル・スピーシーズである地球人へ（益子祐司/訳、徳間書店 2022年4月 ISBN 978-4-19-865443-6 金星人オムネクとの対話の改訂版 至高なる神性の法則　次元上昇した「金星」の真相と地球の未来（益子祐司/訳、徳間書店 2023年3月 ISBN 978-4-19-865529-7『私はアセンションした惑星から来た』の改題新装版

外部リンク

オムネク・オネク公式サイト　[1] OMNEC ONEC ~ The Woman from Venus https://omnec-onec.com/

翻訳者（益子祐司）による解説ページ　[2] オムネク・オネクについて – 益子祐司 ブログ http://emerald.holy.jp/?page_id=1414

ref: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%AA%E3%83%A0%E3%83%8D%E3%82%AF%E3%83%BB%E3%82%AA%E3%83%8D%E3%82%AF

(*3)​

オムネク・オネクについて – 益子祐司 ブログ http://emerald.holy.jp/?page_id=1414

講演動画(1:11:56)​

Omnec Onec 🛸 UFO - From Venus I Came - Presentation 1991 ✨ Intro by Wendelle C. Stevens

動画概要欄​

1,800 views Premiered Mar 10, 2024

Full presentation by Omnec Onec, worldwide known as "The Woman from Venus", premiering on YouTube March 9, 9.11 p.m. CET. 👉 • Omnec Onec 🛸 UFO - From Venus I Came ...

Introduction by Wendelle C. Stevens, first publisher of her autobiography of an extraterrestrial "From Venus I Came", 1991.

FasterWhisper AI(large-v2 model) + DeepL(2024-07 model)​

Details

▼文字起こし 展開 司会者(Wendelle Stevens)：

I was tuned into a radio station in Chicago some 17 years ago and they had a radio talk show going on and they had a speaker who was answering questions from the audience so beautifully and in such a nice voice and so clearly and there were certainly hecklers and we got some here She can handle them too. And she did so well at this that I had to contact her because I had already been working with people, other people, humans, who have a conscious recollection of their history that does include life on Venus. Now, the life on Venus does not exist in the same vibrational frequencies as our own here. (0:00:54)

It's different. And there are stages of densification, stages of change that you go through to get here. And I'm sure that Omnic can describe these a whole lot better than I can. So let me present Omnic Anyik. She was born on Venus, made the transition stages to the intensification step by step. She is in the same body she was, or the same spirit she was born in, on Venus. She has a full conscious recollection of the steps and the stages. (0:01:23)

She was not born on this planet, Omnic.

金星人の登場：

Wendell is my favorite person here. We've been in contact for many years. And I've just had the joy of meeting him for the first time physically. And it was a wonderful experience. He's exactly what I expected, a warm, wonderful-haired human being. I appreciate everything he's went through to present something like this. It's been very hard for him. (0:02:03)

He's gone through a lot of difficulties, as I have myself. I have never experienced anything quite as beautiful as you people. The love and the general, honest interest is just more than I expected.

聴衆:

We can't hear back here.

You can't hear me. I'll try to speak a little louder. Closer to the mic. Closer to the mic. Is that better? Yeah, that's good. Alright. I was hoping that because I looked so similar to yourself, that it wouldn't be a big disappointment. (0:02:43)

I was intending it to be an inspiration. Because, of course, what I have to tell you is that I and my people, along with other people in this solar system, have been coming to Earth for thousands of years because we originally colonized the Earth thousands and thousands of years ago with the races that do exist here now. And so we felt the need, through all this time, to guide you and try to keep you in balance with your surroundings since you have lost track of your heritage. (0:03:22)

And the only difference in myself coming here is that I actually came as a child and grew up in your society and went through many turmoil, emotional and physical experiences that weren't very pleasant, as many of you have, of course, experienced in your lifetime. The wonderful thing about it is it has enabled me to have compassion and understanding and communicate on a level that I wouldn't have been able to if I had stayed there as an adult and then come here. (0:03:56)

My consciousness would have been so different. It would have been very difficult for me to reach you as I do now. (0:04:05)

The thing that is wonderful about living here is I did learn a great deal from each of you. I learn every day from human beings and it's enlightening to see the struggles that are going on for the insights and things that you need. But I was born on Venus in this lifetime. So I'm very aware of them. Adamski was one of the people that was one of our first contacts here. Yes sir? When we said that we left our bodies, we felt very... No, it's the same. (0:40:34)

In a physical universe, it's like the lowest plane you can go to. All the physical universes, all the solar systems, everything including planet Earth. It's like you drop a rock in water and everything goes out in a circle. We're in the middle. This is the lowest point of existence. It's like solid. (0:40:51)

As you go upward on these circles, it gets less and less materialistic and less and less of a body as we know it. Our body is like sheath over sheath over the soul. As the soul goes up, it drops these sheaths on those planes. When you get to the God world, you're more or less just a light or a soul. The God world would be different from your world. (0:41:13)

No, everything is the same. Everything is located in the same aspect. How much of Earth's destiny are you aware of and what that you're aware of can you share with us? Well, every planet has to go through stages and we're in the Iron Age. No, no, excuse me, Earth. Earth, Earth is in the Iron Age. It's got to go through the stages like any other planet does. (0:41:37)

It's got to grow and develop and the consciousness has to be raised to a point. There's going to have to be a revolution in this time. Excuse me one more time. Excuse me, but we're on a time in the age of Aquarius, a transition. Well, yes, it is called the Iron Age. If you go down through the... we're in the Iron Age and then you transcend into the Golden Age. And another sense of talking like a... if you read back into some of the prophecies of time, you have to go through a sort of revolution here, where the people are not willing to be manipulated anymore, where they're going to walk away from the material thing and stand up, realize the individual power. (0:42:17)

The source of individualism is very strong. Think about the factories, the airports. Everything is manufactured and run by you, not by the people that own these things. There's very few of them. There's very many of you. This has to happen at one time or another. Yes, ma'am. Yes, sir. I've noticed some of your artwork and do you have a... These are things you have to come into on your own. (0:43:10)

You can study, but you really have to practice. I was supposed to actually go down my alphabet and share it with you, but then they told me not to because it's not appropriate and it's not exact as it should be because we have too many words in our language that didn't comprehend with yours, so it didn't work out properly. The letters and stuff didn't balance out. (0:43:33)

So I'm not capable of doing it. Really, I just don't have the proper background for it. Would you please repeat the questions because we can't hear in the back. Oh, exactly, if I could. Was I capable of an art form or drawing to share with you? Have the steps of non-publicity, you know, to teach this to people? Right. Well, they can pick up your thoughts. (0:44:10)

They can pick up your thoughts if you send them out very easily, but you may not be able to pick them up and return. (0:44:17)

But this is like something you just have to practice and learn to do, you know, on your own. There's many books written on it. If you're really interested in it, then you should just get all the knowledge you can and read about it. And I think you can reawaken that ability within yourself if you really have the desire which you seem to have. (0:44:35)

Yes, ma'am. I have a body just like your own. Except there's a few differences in my skin texture, my digestive system, the way my heart beats a little faster. I manufacture my own calcium. I have different structural differences. But basically, it's pretty much the same as your own. Yes, just like you. Did you photograph your aura? No, but many people have told me they can see the aura. (0:45:14)

I can see the aura on people at times. But no, I've never had it photographed, but I've been told about it. Yes, sir. Yes, how would you explain Venus's record-grade rotation? I don't know. You know, I'm not really a scientist, and I'm not aware. To tell you the truth, I have read very little books in my lifetime. All my knowledge is just from when I grew up on Venus and what I've gathered here in my everyday life. (0:45:44)

But I was given the knowledge and wrote down everything I could about how the shifts work from my uncle and also Odamsky's book. They told me to get his books and get the drawings out of them because they were absolutely correct and they had been given to Odamsky. But I'm not really a scientifically based person. You are aware that Venus is the only planet in the solar system that rotates in the backward direction of the day, on Venus it's 142 days. (0:46:13)

Right. That's what I said. We have a different aging process because of the way our planet is. You know, we do age different. We live to be 500 years old. It's very complicated. But it's just part of when it manifested to the state it is now. The whole physical planet changed as well as the life on it. Did you enjoy being there in the sulfuric acid rain and the carbon dioxide atmosphere? (0:46:38)

Well, when I was there, it wasn't very much different than your own desert. Our body is very adaptable. I didn't find it that difficult to exist there. I think a lot of what you've been told is just what they want you to think. How long did it take you to get there? Um... Oh, all the way back to the beginning. We have a recorded history at the beginning of all the planets. (0:47:15)

That's part of our knowledge. I didn't write about it in my book because it wasn't really necessary. I went through as much history as I could. Hundreds of thousands of years. Our solar system is very old. There is a possibility that the planet itself was already made. (0:47:46)

I mean, when it came here, it was already in existence. But it's been around for hundreds of thousands of years. It just came into this solar system. It was transported here from another galaxy. But I don't go into the details and all that because it wasn't important to my mission. If it's important, I would have been given more knowledge about it. But it wasn't an important part of the physical... Did you give any information about the planet? (0:48:12)

It was just... What can you say? Everything that happens has a purpose, you know. The Supreme Being is like a very special being. It made sure that it would never cease to exist by creating thousands and millions of living things from itself so that it would continue to recreate itself. So there's a purpose and a reason for everything that happens and takes place. (0:48:35)

And we really don't have a right to question that. We just... when we get the knowledge, we should be very pleased with it. And those questions of the Supreme Being are questions that fascinate the idea of a civilization surviving a journey from one galaxy to another. They do it every day. They come in from other galaxies all the time. These are the strange human beings that you see that don't look like you. (0:48:57)

But this is an important matter. But that's still a possibility. It's a possibility that you may not comprehend, but it's possible. Yes? Here in your physical form, do you still possess powers such as photographic memory or anything like that? Actually, my memory on Earth is limited much more than it was on Venus. Because of my physical handicaps that I run into, I have a lot of... I don't remember as clearly here. (0:49:24)

I remember everything there. I still have powers here. They're limited. I don't use them very much because of spiritual laws. Yes? Is there anything we can do about the intrusive race, civilization, which has been possibly somewhat of a problem? I don't know. I feel that this is something that the government is choosing to terrorize people. I don't feel that they're really a threat from somewhere else. (0:49:50)

Do you feel at all? Oh, sure. It affects everyone. It's just that... If the only planet was one moon and it was exfertized and our individual bodies having so much of the liquid, of course it's going to affect you with pressures and things. When we first colonized the Earth, we utilized a chart for certain methods of liquids to drink at certain times of the moon, phases of the moon, which still exist. (0:50:20)

I mean, they're found somewhere on Earth and someone's still looking for those charts. Yes? It's one of them other planets. Yes. Well, see, that's what I'm saying. The four major planets that colonized the Earth are, of course, the older planets, and they did bring life, human forms of life here. Since then, of course, Earth does have its own races because they have intermixed. (0:51:05)

And now we have thousands and thousands of races here, which is a mixture of these races. (0:51:10)

So what I'm trying to do is just help you to trace back a little some of your heritage. And when you reach for the stars sometimes and you see things out there, they're just trying to reconnect you with your own past. Do you think that's related to being born? No. Do you think that's related to being born? No. How much do you know about that? (0:51:29)

I don't know about that for sure. Honestly, like I said, I don't read very many books, honestly. Everything that I'm telling you is just my own knowledge. And if I read other books, it would confuse my mind whether I would be... I wasn't sure if I would be writing my own recollections or something that I've read. So I wasn't really interested in reading a lot of books. (0:51:49)

I probably read more now that I've got my book written than I have in my whole lifetime. Yes. Do you think that's related to being born? It's a possibility. There's a lot of people who have been visiting here from different solar systems since then. That's a great possibility in which I'm sure that the answers will come forward sooner or later. Some person is going to come forward with some information on that, a being maybe that went through this kind of transition. (0:52:22)

Yes, sir. What is your mission here? You seem to be rather vague and don't understand much about a lot of questions. You don't seem to be very curious if you don't read. I'm curious as to where you get your information from and what is your purpose here? My information came from my experiences. My purpose is just exactly what I'm doing, trying to bring you in touch with your own past. (0:52:52)

I can only give you information and knowledge. And what you do with it, I can't force you to believe or disbelieve anything that I have to say. I can only present you with the knowledge. And if you discard that knowledge, that's fine. I'm not a debatable person. I'm not into debating or arguing the point because it just takes time and it doesn't accomplish anything. (0:53:16)

Yes, sir. Can you share with us what you love most about Venus? The harmony, the ability for the people to have the strength to change the form of government, very much like your own, where that they had a class structure and they were very unhappy. They didn't have equality, they didn't have balance. They didn't know their own self-worth and they were turned upon one another because of some having more than others having. (0:53:51)

They didn't have the individual feeling of their importance. And when a man doesn't have a self-awareness of what he's worth, he tends to look for other ways to be superior, which is always putting down someone for their religion or how much money they have or what they look like. And this is what causes the inequality that exists here. To step away from these things and to break away from these things takes a lot of strength and courage. (0:54:20)

And we didn't have an easy time. (0:54:23)

It wasn't just overnight that we walked away and left all of our, what would you call it, luxuries that we were used to, like depending on electricity and everyday conveniences that we had gotten used to. It was very difficult for us to migrate into the country and have no way to take care of ourselves. We had to build our own homes and grow our own food. (0:54:44)

And those that didn't know how to build homes had to ask others how to do it. They had to share with us how to grow a garden or how to make clothing. It took a long time and a lot of effort and strength. And I admire the fact that they were able to do this and able to transcend all of the bounds that were holding them. (0:55:03)

And then the handful of few people that monopolized all these powers and that possessed the control over these people fled the planet because they didn't want the change. So I love most their ability to transcend all these things and their willingness to come here thousands of years to try to guide the colonies that they felt that they were responsible for here. To try to help them to become what they should be and to overcome the limits that have been set upon them. (0:55:34)

Yes? Perhaps some of your knowledge... On every plane of existence you... Could you repeat that question? Okay, yes. On a matter of... You want to know what realms... If you go on different realms, they have conflicts and things going on. And it's true. No matter how aware you are or what plane of existence you're on, there are still problems, still lessons to be learned. (0:56:00)

You never stop learning. No matter... If you leave this life, you're going to run, even on the higher planes, you're going to run into different kind of attachments and things that you will go through. There's entities there that will convince you that they are the God. They want you to stay on that realm. And you have to experience things there. You don't stop having difficulties and you don't stop learning lessons because you leave the physical world. (0:56:22)

It's just a different set and a different form of experiences and changes to go through. Yes, ma'am? What do you want to learn about the Earth? Well, the variety of people, consciousness, the beauty of the Earth itself. It has so many different parts of it that are so different. I love most of all, I guess, the struggle I see for people to find the truth and the lovingness. (0:57:00)

I've never met a human being that wasn't capable of offering help. Once you speak to them, you're not a stranger. That's something I like. It's like, even if they don't speak your language, they try to help you. And I think that's really wonderful. And I love how I've been accepted and how wonderful you've been towards me, you know, being a visitor from somewhere else. (0:57:31)

And how you've just accepted me into your society. (0:57:33)

Yes? How accepted would you be if you'd come from Jupiter? Well, I would have been black, but I suppose I would have... If I had grown up here as a child, I would have been very well accepted. Yes? How would you recommend to people to join the global program? Well, I don't know what I can tell people to help them, except what I've just done. (0:58:10)

When I've written my book and given them the knowledge that I've given them, I'm hoping that it can help them as a unit. I can't really do much myself. But every individual has a part to play, and they have to find what that part is, and they have to do the best they can to help raise the consciousness and to spread the knowledge. (0:58:27)

That's what I'm hoping that we're here for. Yes, sir? You said the people on Venus couldn't accept me through tradition, but by receiving knowledge of where they are. Oh, yeah. They're the very ones that preyed on the first colonies here. That caused them to lose their knowledge of their background because they were having to battle these people. They came right here and preyed on the very colonies that came here to colonize the Earth. They preyed on Atlantis and Lemuria and these first colonies because they wanted to control them, to have power. (0:59:05)

And they tried to prey on their weaknesses. In the struggle to survive, a lot of them lost their knowledge as to where they had actually come from. Yes? Just share with everybody as much as you can the knowledge that you possess and the truth that you're aware of. Every person is searching in one way or another, no matter what path they're on, they're still searching for the same truth. (0:59:37)

We're all going in the same direction. And I think just talking and sharing is the best thing you can do. If you have some trait that you can add to our mission, then the best thing you can do is try to start building a ship, try working on magnetic energy if those are your abilities. If you're working in the press or if you're working in a way that you can put information out, then do it. (1:00:02)

Make movies, give talks, invite people on that are interested in these things. Just spread the knowledge. Yes? In your religion, do you have any studies like these? Oh sure, we do have people that we look up to in our history, spiritual leaders. Zadrian was the one that led the people from the city, from the struggles and turmoils of the class structures. We have many people actually doing all walks of life that we admire. (1:00:33)

But we tend not to worship anyone because that is not actually the thing you're supposed to do. You're supposed to take the knowledge they give to you and use it. Yes? I wouldn't know. I know that they've all been tested for their IQ in school because they were in accelerated classes. (1:00:54)

They tend to be a little different than a lot of children. Are they half human and half... They're half human and half earth people. Do they have blood stress? I don't know if there's any biological difference other than my children. One of my sons weighed almost 13 pounds when he was born because I do tend to carry my children longer. Which was, you know, the doctors were wondering about that. (1:01:22)

It only happens usually in people with diabetes and I didn't have that problem. I didn't tend to go into labor on my own so I had a problem of carrying the children too long. But they were all very well developed, very healthy, and have never been interested in drugs or any of the things that other children get off into. They're more interested in furthering their own lives and they have a great balance and harmony about them. (1:01:49)

Which, I've watched them grow up and I see that they're a little different. Everybody's come to tell me what remarkable children I have so I suppose they're a little different. But I think it's my teaching more than anything. Yes ma'am? Regarding your children, do they share any genetic memory or recall of Isha? No, they don't because their soul may have existed somewhere else. (1:02:13)

One daughter, when she was three years old, had complete recall of being an Isha girl in Japan. Tried to eat with the handles of all the utensils. Completely described her life there. I mean, she was only three years old. She didn't have a television at the time. I was engrossed in teaching my children to spell and write and we painted pictures and stuff. (1:02:34)

But she was always telling me about, when I would tell her to turn the fork over and eat the other way, she would say, but that's how I always ate. And I'm saying, where? When did you eat like that? And she would tell me. So, children do have recalls of past lives, but we don't usually cultivate them enough to get questions or answers from them. (1:02:51)

We usually think it's their imagination. Yes? Yes, they're every day like that. Right. I don't know, I think it's sort of humorous. If I become famous for my book and I'm on television for interviews and stuff and they happen to see me, they're going to feel, they're going to be quite appalled because I've actually served them breakfast or drinks or whatever. And when they remember this, it's going to be, you know, they're going to be sitting there feeling pretty strange. (1:03:29)

Oh no, I don't go around telling everyone I'm from Dean. But you see, I share it with certain people that I, right. But when the book came out now, I did run into people finding out about it because I gave the book to certain people that I worked with. They were so delighted and so engrossed with the book, they couldn't put it down. (1:03:53)

I mean, these are just regular, everyday waitresses, people that are not, you know, very educated in the metaphysical. (1:03:58)

They're engrossed. They went around telling everyone. I signed and autographed away all my books that I first got from Wendell, which was a box of 30, to all the people at the apparel center and offices. They came down and bought them at the bar. My girlfriend was bartending. I was in there autographing books and selling books to these people. And to beat it all, one old man was really interested. (1:04:21)

I went over and talked to him for a few moments, and he was very familiar with Wendell Stevens. He had all of his books. He had a collection of them. And he said, you know, if you have something to do with Wendell Stevens, I'm certainly going to buy the book. Bought the book from me. And I was surprised at the interest of just ordinary, everyday people. (1:04:37)

It's more than, what, 15 years ago. I mean, now there's a genuine interest. People know that there's something going on because in different parts of the world, they've got the same reports, the same descriptions in different languages. How can this happen? It isn't coincidence. It has to be true. And they're awakening to this because there's more news media and there's more information available. (1:04:57)

My son is on the computer line, and he constantly prints out things that he finds, calls me up about UFOs, sends out messages to people if they have any information about it. They'll send it to him. He prints it out. We've run across Wendell's name hundreds of times. But there's more of a communication now. So people are aware, and they are ready to know. (1:05:18)

Even just the most mundane person is interested. And that's one thing that I was surprised to see. They didn't think I was crazy. They worked with me an awful lot. They knew the charisma I had. They knew that people, unordinarily, they would come up and ask who I was when I was working there. They always, always generated an interest in me, and that was unusual. (1:05:40)

So they knew there was something different about me. People always say that, there's something different about you. I hear that a lot. I don't know what to say. I can't just tell them what it is. You know, because I'm always afraid of someone saying that I'm crazy. But, well, they say it's my imagination. That's good. Because the imagination is at least the father of everything that exists here. (1:06:03)

So that's not so bad. But to say that you're crazy is a different kind of thing that I'm not really ready for. Yes? I think it's something like this happens. Surprisingly enough, there are many ships that want to evacuate many people here. Not the politicians or the high officials, necessarily. They're going to be concerned with themselves anyway. They're going to be running around with their own little things, you know, to save themselves. (1:06:54)

But they're going to be interested in people like us. People who have worked toward trying to spread the message. (1:07:02)

People, they know who we are. So we're going to be taking care of them, I'm sure. Well, one of them escorted me here on the plane. They were at a distance. I've seen them over in the clouds. Is it a safe area? Is it considered to be a safe area? I don't know. Nobody knows where I am. I guess I'm safe. I'm not really... see, I'm not concerned with my physical safety because I'm already aware of what's going to happen to me after this life is over. (1:07:40)

So it's not like I have a great fear of losing this body. It's not a big deal to me. How about your children? My children? They're more concerned with my safety than I am. They worry about me constantly. They thought I was going to be kidnapped when I came out here because I'm by myself. One of them did. The rest of them were telling me to be careful. (1:07:57)

My 19-year-old son was extremely proud of me. He had taken several books for his friends. And my mother was crying. I mean, it's terrible. I'm only going for a week or so. I told them not to, you know, in fear I was going to come back. But it was like, they're very protective of me. I really appreciate talking to you. I know I can't stay here all night. (1:08:19)

But I, you know, I just wish I could answer all of your questions. I know I can't. Ma'am, I'll go ahead and answer yours. Your hand is sticking up in the air for an hour. Go ahead. Oh, yeah. I know all of my past lives. I have access to the Kashuk records. I can read lives for other people. But I don't do this because, you know, there's a taboo on doing this. (1:08:45)

You know, because of spiritual laws. You do things like this to take karma upon yourself, and I'm not willing to do that. I can do it on occasion if I'm really close to someone and I really desire to, if I get permission. But I'm aware of all of my past lives. And I'm sure that everyone in this room has shared at least one or two with me. (1:09:06)

I can just feel it when I see you and when I'm around you. I know all of you. Somehow or another, I know you. At other times, I know you with soul. I feel this with all my heart. Yes? Thank you. One of the other speakers at the Congress this week had talked about that they find that most contactees or abductions are positive, that the U.S. is the only place that is having what we call negative abductions. (1:09:39)

Can you give us any further information on this? Well, that's what I said. I believe, really, this wasn't happening back in the 50s. This is something that has just been happening as far as I have noticed in years. I think it's because of the interest that is generated towards UFOs. I think it's a tactic of the government to scare people. (1:10:01)

And in some of them, of course, there are astral entities that break through for a moment, and people really think that it's UFOs or they're having experiences because they open themselves up to this. And you have to be careful that you don't get preyed upon by opening yourself up psychically and not protecting yourself. You can really endanger your own self. Because they're very tricky beings that live above the physical world on the other planes. (1:10:25)

They're just waiting to get a chance to damage you in some way. So you have to be very careful and try to keep your balance. You know if you really have an encounter. I mean, it's a physical thing. There's physical evidence. So there's a lot of different things that are going on. And if you went around through this Congress, you can gather information. (1:10:45)

And it's like putting a puzzle together piece by piece. It's all the same picture, but it's different aspects of it, you know. And if you have the knowledge, you can sort of put it together on your own when you go home. You'll think about it and you'll really understand what's going on. I want to thank all of you very much. I wish I had the time to spend with you forever. (1:11:07)

But I'm really getting, like, my mouth is dry. I'm getting tired. But I did want, out of curiosity, I meant to show you my hands. Because people had asked me before. The shape of my hands was supposed to be very unusual. The Venetian hands are like, shaped like a flame. All the outer fingers of our hands curve toward the middle finger, which is very straight. (1:11:25)

And people have noticed that. So I thought that I would hold my hand up for you so you can see before I go. And, you know, sort of just answer a few questions. And I want to thank all of you very, very much. (1:11:37)

(2024-12-29)

entry.title: 「DMT で体験する異世界は実在だ」説を反証する
entry.content:
前置き​

Andrew Gallimore が「DMT で体験する異世界は実在だ」という、よくある主張をしているので、以下ではそれを取り上げ、反証しておく。

要旨​

DMT の世界は脳が（夢のように）でっちあげたものではない。別の実在する高次元世界から情報を受け取っているのだ

FasterWhisper AI(large-v2 model) + DeepL(2024-07 model)​

人々は、DMTの世界は脳が構築したものなのか、それとも別の現実なのかと言う。通常の覚醒している世界は脳によって構築されるが、それが環境からの情報にマッピングされていることは分かっている。 (0:40:55)

夢の世界は脳によって構築される。DMTの世界も同じだ。別の世界を体験したければ、それは脳によって構築されなければならない。では、DMTの世界は脳によって構築されているのか、ということが問題なのではない。問題は、その世界は別の場所にマッピングされているのか、ということだ。脳はその別の空間から、何らかの別の形の感覚情報を受け取っているのだろうか？ (0:41:25）

、ここでもまた、DMTの世界が知覚された世界である可能性があるというアイデアを、私はブレーク会議で話した。そして、DMTの世界に行くとき、脳がDMTの世界を構築しているのは、脳が実際にこの別の現実から情報を受け取っているからであり、その情報を使ってこのモデルを構築し、それをDMTの世界として体験しているのだ。しかし、あなたの脳は常にそれを構築しなければならない。これは興味深いことでしょう？ (0:41:55)

これは、C.D.ブロードやオルダス・ハクスリーのような人たちの考えを応用したもので、アンリ・ベルクソンにさかのぼると、脳は減衰器として働くという考え方がある。しかし、DMTの作用は、私の理解が正しければ、脳が情報を減衰させる機能を無効にし、別のところから情報が入ってくるようにするということのようだ。 (0:42:32)

People say, is the DMT world constructed by the brain, or is it a different reality? Your normal waking world is constructed by your brain, but we know that it's mapped to information from the environment. (0:40:55)

The dream world is constructed by your brain. The same with the DMT world. If you want to experience another world, it has to be constructed by your brain. Now, the question then is not, is the DMT world constructed by a brain, because we know that it must be. The question is, is that world mapped to some kind of other place? Is the brain receiving information, some kind of alternate form of sensory information from this other space? (0:41:25)

And again, this is what I spoke about at the breaking convention, the idea that the DMT world could be a sensed world, and that when you go to this, the reason your brain is constructing this DMT world is because it's actually receiving information from this other reality, and thus is kind of using that information to construct this model, which is experienced by you as the DMT world. But your brain always has to construct it. This is interesting, isn't it? (0:41:55)

Because this is an application of the ideas of people like C.D. Broad, and individuals like Aldous Huxley, and the idea, and going back to Henri Bergson, and the idea that the brain acts as an attenuator, the brain takes out information in order for us to function effectively within this environment, whatever this external phenomenal world is that we experience. But it seems that what DMT does, if I'm understanding you correctly, is it seems to override the brain's ability to attenuate information, and it allows information to be coming in from somewhere else. (0:42:32)

Dr. Andrew Gallimore is a computational neurobiologist, pharmacologist, chemist, and writer who has been interested in the neural basis of psychedelic drug action for many years and is the author of a number of articles and research papers on the powerful psychedelic drug, N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and its effects on the brain and consciousness. He recently collaborated with DMT pioneer Dr. Rick Strassman, author of DMT: The Spirit Molecule, to develop a pharmacokinetic model of DMT as the basis of a target-controlled intravenous infusion protocol for extended journeys in DMT space.

His current interests focuses on DMT as a tool for gating access to extradimensional realities and how this can be understood in terms of the neuroscience of information. He currently lives and works in Japan.

「DMT で体験する異世界は実在だ」説を反証する​

Andrew Gallimore は上の引用箇所以外でもタイトルの件に関連して饒舌に語っているが、それらの発言は一行に要約できる。それは、

  • (a) DMT 摂取で体験した世界は、（夢や幻覚とは全く異なり）「現実の存在」（＝実在）だと、強く確信した

ということに尽きる。

ここで

  • (b) DMT 体験中の意識状態は、正常（＝日常の目覚めた意識状態）ではない

ことが問題となる。

正常ではない意識状態で何をどのように体験しようと、それは現実の体験だとは見なせない。なぜなら「現実」や「実在」という言葉それ自体が「日常の目覚めた意識状態」での体験を暗黙の前提にしているゆえに。

つまり、a は b という欠陥があるゆえ、論拠とはなりえない。

His current interests focuses on DMT as a tool for gating access to extradimensional realities and how this can be understood in terms of the neuroscience of information. He currently lives and works in Japan.

この「超越的な知的存在」の正体を解く​

DMT にカブれた連中は揃いも揃って皆、ウブイようだ。Terrence McKenna しかり、Martin Ball しかり。

Andrew Gallimore のタイトルの発言を聞いて真っ先に浮かぶのは、

  • DMT 摂取で対面した存在が「超越的な知性」を持っていると、どうしてわかったのか？

という疑問だが、当然ながらそれに対するまともな答えはない。本来なら、

  • その存在から超越的な 啓示/智慧/知識 を授かり、
  • その内容を克明に語ることができる

必要があるが、それをなしえた DMT 体験者は誰一人としていない。

この点で、

  • (a) 非日常的な意識状態（幻覚薬物/NDE/abduction/大悟/解脱）において超越的な 啓示/智慧/知識 を授かり、
  • (b) 宇宙と融即した、全ての真理を知った、世界の最奥の真理を理解したが、
  • (c) その真理の詳しい内容は、言詮不及 だの、不立文字、直指人心、教外別伝、可及其智 不可及其愚 とやらで表現できない

と宣う多様な意識変容時（＝一時的な意識障害の最中）の神秘体験者と症状は共通している。

この共通点を理解すると、Andrew Gallimore が対面した「超越的な知的存在」の正体が見えてくる。

その正体とは Andrew Gallimore の抱いていた超越妄想が姿を変えたものに過ぎない。つまり、彼の超越妄想が一時的な意識障害の最中において、「超越的な知的存在」の扮装をして立ち顕れただけ。

言い換えると、

  • ジャンキーがラリって鏡の中の自分を魔物だと誤認し、真夜中に大騒ぎ

とよく似ている。魔物の正体は自分自身。同様に

  • Andrew Gallimore が対面した「超越的な知的存在」の正体は彼自身の抱いていた超越妄想

超越妄想である証拠が、

  • (b) 宇宙と融即した、全ての真理を知った、世界の最奥の真理を理解したが、
  • (c) その真理の詳しい内容は、言詮不及 だの、不立文字、直指人心、教外別伝、可及其智 不可及其愚 とやらで表現できない

という証言に露見している（のだが、同じ超越妄想を抱くウブな信者はこれこそ本物の証だと信じ込んでしまう）。

初恋を成就して世界がピンク色に染まって見えている少女は微笑ましいが、大の大人が DMT 体験ごときでいつまでものぼせ上がって熱が冷めないのはウブすぎる。
